doc.description: Ground Object Detector (with gate detection) Detects ground, obstacles, plants, and the TU Delft gate from a Bebop image. Publishes results via TEAM10_GROUND_DETECTION and TEAM10_GATE_DETECTION ABI messages with sender ID TEAM10_GROUND_DETECTION_ID / TEAM10_GATE_DETECTION_ID.

define.name: COLOR_OBJECT_DETECTOR_DRAW1
define.description: Whether or not to draw on image

define.name: TEAM10_GROUND_DETECTION_ID
define.description: ABI sender ID for ground/obstacle/plant messages

define.name: TEAM10_GATE_DETECTION_ID
define.description: ABI sender ID for gate detection messages
